prompt:
Triangles O N M and S R Q are shown. Angles O N M and S R Q are congruent. The length of side N M is 10 and the length of side S R is 20. The length of side N O is 8 and the length of side Q R is x.
What value of x will make △ONM  similar to △SRQ by the SAS similarity theorem?

16
20
25
50
judge_reasoning: The correct SAS similarity setup should match the sides that include the congruent angles: NO corresponds to QR and NM corresponds to SR, so 8/x = 10/20 giving x = 16. Candidate 1 uses this correspondence correctly and arrives at 16. Candidates 2, 3, and 4 use incorrect proportional relationships (they effectively pair the wrong sides), leading to x = 25, so they are incorrect.
